title: The left’s fortunes have been rising. Will 2028 be AOC’s moment?
contentHtml:
The “drafts” we’ve periodically conducted for the 2028 Democratic and Republican nominations are popular features with Silver Bulletin readers. No apologies for that.

I’m not going to tell you that 2028 is the most important election of all time, because people say that about every election. But having a truly open nomination in both parties is relatively rare, and they’ll each have the chance — really the obligation — to redefine themselves in the first presidential election since 2012 that doesn’t include Donald Trump. Beyond that, it feels like the country is on the brink of profound political change, whether driven by technological shifts or generational turnover as various Boomer political dynasties burn themselves out.
